input.quote: Effective on the License Option Exercise Closing Date, as between the Parties, AbbVie shall have the sole right, at its expense, to Manufacture (or have Manufactured) and supply the Licensed Compound and Licensed Products for commercial sale in the Territory by AbbVie and its Affiliates and Sublicensees.
input.rationale: The agreement imposes no minimum purchase or take-or-pay obligation on AbbVie. Consideration under Article 6 is an upfront payment plus event-based development/regulatory milestones and sales-based royalties, i.e., payable only on actual achievement and actual Net Sales, with no minimum annual royalty or shortfall mechanic (searches for "minimum", "shortfall", "take or pay", "commit to purchase" and "minimum royalty" return only insurance limits). On supply, Section 4.5.1 gives AbbVie the sole right to Manufacture or have Manufactured commercial supply, so there is no obligation to purchase volumes from Harpoon, and Sections 4.5.2–4.5.3 run in our favour (Harpoon-side technology transfer obligations). Diligence/commercially reasonable efforts undertakings are not minimum commitments for this rule. This meets the preferred position; no redline needed.
